universe.description: strongest stocks US equities mid/large caps most liquid

setup.rule: big absolute and relative momentum then pullback or sideways consolidation with volatility contraction
setup.quote: you have a leg higher and then it usually goes sideways or pull backs pulls back and uh many times what happens is the volatility contracts like it gets tighter

entry.rule: buy opening range high on daily breakout confirmation
entry.quote: i buy the opening range highs and the opening range highs is when the stock takes out uh obviously it has to be a breakout first

stop.rule: initial stop low of day then trail 10 or 20 day MA waiting for close
stop.quote: initially my stop is always low low sodium day uh and once the moving averages the 10 and the 20 uh the moving averages it depends on the stock the faster moving stops are you stocks i moved uh i used the 10 day and the slow we're moving once i use the 20 day

exits.rule: scale out 20-25% into first burst of strength then trail rest with MA hold as long as possible
exits.quote: i always sell some into that first burst uh to lock in a little bit of profits maybe i sell 20 or 25 or it can vary a lot

sizing.rule: buy everything at once aggressively no scaling in unless new setup
sizing.quote: i buy everything at once uh very aggressively

market_filter.rule: only uptrending or sideways market after correction prefer stocks with relative strength
market_filter.quote: you obviously need uh uh up trending or sideways market to trade this method

ambiguities.issue: exact consolidation range pct or days not specified
ambiguities.assumption: use 20-60 days with max 15% range for daily approximation
